enabled.title: Use the profile account
enabled.description: Turns the extension on or off for every profile. Users can't change it when set.

hintMode.title: When a site already asks for a specific account
hintMode.description: always = use the profile account instead (default). missing = keep the site's choice.

accountPicker.title: When a site asks the user to pick an account
accountPicker.description: skip = skip the picker and use the profile account (default). site = show the picker.

includeFrames.title: Include background sign-ins in hidden frames
includeFrames.description: Also add the profile account to silent sign-ins that sites run in iframes. Default: true.

excludedSites.title: Excluded sites
excludedSites.description: Host names (subdomains included) whose sign-ins are left alone, for example dev.azure.com. Replaces the user's own list.

allowPause.title: Allow users to pause
allowPause.description: Shows the Pause button that lets a user sign in with a different account for 15 minutes. Default: true.

allowedDomains.title: Only for these account domains
allowedDomains.description: Only act when the profile account's email domain is in this list (subdomains included), for example contoso.com. Empty or unset = any account.
